mood: The hometown lullaby — lanterns in the dark, cosy and a little homesick. The source of the Vesper motif.
_note: The approved v3 take; its first chunk was conditioned on the original Take B upload (xhigh). This take IS the motif source (motif.json) so it carries no motif block itself.
core_styles: warm music-box and soft pulse-wave lead

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a short memorable 4-bar opening flourish: rising music-box arpeggio, then the lead boldly states the first notes of the main theme, landing on a held chord that leads straight into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the main melody, clear and front and centre, simple and hummable, played by the soft pulse-wave lead over harp arpeggios}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again, now answered by a gentle flute counter-melody, strings a little fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a wistful turn to A minor, the melody moves lower and slower, homesick and tender, then lifts back toward home}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the main melody returns in full, warm and complete; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
